verdict.rationale: Penpot's homepage claims you can 'design responsive and rules-based interfaces' with CSS Grid and Flex layouts, which covers the auto-layout and grid parts of the story. That support rests on a single marketing line, and constraints are never mentioned. Missing for 10: any evidence of constraints/resizing behavior, in-depth help docs on flex/grid layout behavior, and hands-on or community corroboration that frames actually resize responsively.
